subject: Request for Pollination Contract Details
body_text:
Hi there, 

I hope this email finds you well! We’re gearing up for the upcoming season at Goldenridge Fruit Co. and would like to request a clear pollination contract. We're looking for 50 hives for our blueberry block, similar to last year’s arrangement. The expected delivery date is right at the start of the bloom, around March 15th. Please confirm if this fits your schedule or if there are any constraints we should be aware of. 

Thanks for your assistance! Looking forward to hearing from you soon.

Best,  
Leslie Alvarado

subject: Request for Pollination Contract and Hive Details
body_text:
Hi there,  

I hope this message finds you well! I’d like to request a detailed pollination contract for our orchard at Old Mission Farm. We're expecting to use 12 hives for our apple trees, specifically targeting the first bloom around mid-April. If possible, could we arrange for a split delivery? It worked well for us last year. Please let me know if you need any further details or if we can stick to the same parameters as last season.  

Thanks so much for your help!  

Best,  
Laura Odonnell

subject: Inquiry About Pollination Services and Pricing
body_text:
Hi there, 

I’m reaching out on behalf of Old Mission Farm as we prepare for the upcoming season. We’re exploring our options for pollination services, specifically for our orchard trees. Could you provide details on your pricing and availability? Additionally, are there any packages that might be more beneficial for our specific needs? 

Thanks so much for your help! 

Best,  
Beth Williams
